blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Quick revision focuses on high-yield, memorable facts required for competitive examinations.
One-line key facts enable fast retention and rapid active recall during last-minute prep.
Analyzing common exam question areas helps prioritize essential topics for scoring maximum marks.
India drives on the LEFT side of the road.
Overtake from the RIGHT side only.
BAC limit for drivers: 30 mg per 100 ml of blood.
Minimum age to drive a car: 18 years.
Minimum age to drive a transport vehicle: 20 years.
Motorcycle up to 50cc: minimum age 16 years.
A learner's licence is valid for 6 months.
Apply for permanent licence within 30 days of learner's licence (but not before 30 days).
Permanent non-transport licence validity: 20 years or till age 50.
Transport vehicle licence: valid for 3 years.
Third-party insurance is COMPULSORY under Section 146.
PUC certificate required for all vehicles.
Driving without PUC: fine Rs.10,000.
Drunk driving (1st offence): fine Rs.10,000 + jail up to 6 months.
Not giving way to ambulance/fire engine: fine Rs.10,000.
Not wearing seat belt: fine Rs.1,000.
Not wearing helmet: fine Rs.1,000 + 3-month licence suspension.
Mobile phone while driving: fine Rs.1,000–5,000.
Driving without licence: fine Rs.5,000.
Juvenile driving: Rs.25,000 fine on guardian + RC cancelled.
Good Samaritan cannot be harassed by police.
National Emergency number: 112.
Police helpline: 100. Ambulance: 108. Fire Brigade: 101.
Yellow diamond/triangle signs = WARNING signs.
Red circle signs = MANDATORY signs.
Blue rectangle signs = INFORMATORY signs.
Solid white centre line = no overtaking.
Broken white centre line = overtaking allowed with caution.
Zebra crossing = pedestrian right of way.
Speed limit near schools/villages: 25 km/h.
Maximum speed on expressway for cars: 120 km/h.
One-liner key facts are frequently converted directly into objective multiple-choice questions.
Focus heavily on recurring question areas to maximize efficiency in time-critical exams.
Section numbers of MV Act (especially 3, 112, 129, 134, 146, 184, 185)
Fines for various offences after 2019 Amendment
Types of traffic signs and their shapes/colours
Traffic light signals and meanings
Duties of driver after an accident
Good Samaritan rules
Speed limits for different vehicle types
Driving licence rules — age, validity, types
What documents to carry while driving
Right of way and overtaking rules
